name: Grand Rapids Chair Company
old_description: With approachable forms, customizable finishes, and built-in power ready to go, it keeps spaces looking fresh and working smarter. Solid wood or laminate, bold base or neutral tone—Clyde plays well with others.
about:
Grand Rapids Chair Company operates from Byron Center, Michigan, where it was founded in 1991 as Manufacturer's Resource by Dave and Jill Miller. The family-owned business began as a contract furniture sales company before the Millers' son, Geoff, joined in the late 1990s and shifted the focus to designing and building their own seating and tables. The company was renamed Grand Rapids Chair Company, and Geoff assumed leadership in 2012, growing the team to nearly 150 employees.

The company manufactures commercial-grade furniture in its West Michigan factory, working with solid hardwoods, steel, aluminum, and high-performance textiles. Its product line spans chairs, stools, benches, lounge seating, and a range of tables including communal, pedestal, occasional, and T-base models, plus outdoor collections. Finishing capabilities include over 150 powder-coat colors for metal components and a virtually unlimited selection of fabrics, all produced locally to keep lead times short and customization affordable.

Grand Rapids Chair serves the restaurant, office, hospitality, and higher-education markets, supplying design partners and specifiers who furnish gathering spaces such as cafes, hubs, and campus lounges. The portfolio emphasizes versatile, accessible products that can be tailored to specific project palettes.

A family mindset drives the business: the Millers keep manufacturing in Michigan to ensure quality control, fast delivery, and the ability to fulfill one-of-a-kind orders quickly. An industry-leading warranty backs every piece, and the company maintains community ties, including a partnership with the Juvenile Diabetes Research Foundation that inspired the Brooke chair.
